clientDepromDescription: Deprom is a UK-based precast concrete specialist that helps contractors achieve cost certainty, faster programmes, and more sustainable builds. They deliver full-scope precast solutions — brick facades, architectural concrete cladding, and complete residential and commercial frames — backed by in-house engineering, facade, and framing services.

By moving structural and facade work off-site into a controlled factory environment, Deprom reduces programme risk, tightens quality control, and shortens on-site time. Their portfolio spans residential blocks, commercial buildings, and bespoke facade commissions across the UK.
clientLecDescription: LEC — SIA Latvijas Energoceltnieks — is a Baltic leader with more than 30 years of experience in energy and telecommunications construction, supported by a team of 280 professionals. The company designs and builds high-voltage power lines, substations, cable routes, and power generation assets, and rolls out fibre-optic networks at scale.

With Latvia and Germany as its core markets, LEC follows a full-cycle approach — Idea, Challenge, Solution — covering design, construction, modernisation, and maintenance of critical infrastructure. The company is a trusted partner for utilities and telecom operators across Northern Europe.
clientZtcDescription: ZTC is a Latvian manufacturer of prefabricated timber-frame and CLT (cross-laminated timber) houses with over 30 years of experience in European timber construction. Their factory uses CNC precision to produce wall and floor panels with integrated windows, combining CLT and timber-frame technology for residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. ZTC exports turnkey homes to Norway, Sweden, the Netherlands, and Iceland.

ZTC's work has earned the Latvian Construction Annual Award for wooden buildings, and every panel carries CE marking under ETA-21/0014. After talks with two other vendors about automating their manufacturing line, ZTC chose worksRecorded — the third attempt that finally delivered — bringing structure and visibility to their production and site records.
clientStoneAndTreeDescription: Stone & Tree provides paving, landscaping and earthworks services across Latvia.
clientLimeniDescription: Līmenī is a cement screed and concrete flooring specialist with more than 20 years of experience in Latvia’s construction industry.

About.title: About
About.p1: Put AI agents to work on your everyday project data. From WhatsApp conversations to work records, cost control and better estimates.
About.p2: Site management is often overloaded and reluctant to take up additional admin burden to keep records.
About.p3: Even if they exist, records are often scattered, unorganized, and need large effort to be sorted to become useful.
About.p4: When records are missing, it is hard to improve processes, track metrics, argue claims/additional works, account for lost time, or generally understand why things are where they are.
About.p5: Current digital tools are complex, take time and effort to integrate, and are often met with resistance from overloaded site teams.

p6.prefix: Combining construction experience with AI, I created

About.p7: Your agent analyzes existing WhatsApp conversations and turns them into a structured history of work. Every cent has a spending category and a link to your estimate items.
About.p8: This allows site management to spend more time on site, overseeing works, and less time in the office doing admin.
About.p9: Simultaneously, this also lets project management better understand the project so they can analyze, act, and argue their position confidently to the GC/Client.
About.p10: I have used this tool myself and find it simple yet powerful during complicated construction projects.
